name: Gate
author: sloraris@sloraris.dev
description: Gate is a lightweight, high-performance Minecraft reverse proxy from Minekube, written in Go. This egg installs the standalone Gate binary (no Java/JVM).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "-------------------------------------"
echo "Minekube Gate Installer"
echo "-------------------------------------"

cd /mnt/server

# Determine target architecture
ARCH_RAW=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH_RAW}" in
    x86_64) ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH_RAW}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Resolve which release tag to install
if [ -z "${GATE_VERSION}" ] || [ "${GATE_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Looking up latest Gate release..."
    TAG=$(curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/minekube/gate/releases/latest | grep '"tag_name":' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*"tag_name": *"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
else
    TAG="v${GATE_VERSION#v}"
fi

if [ -z "${TAG}" ]; then
    echo "Could not resolve latest release tag from GitHub API, falling back to a known-good version."
    TAG="v0.65.0"
fi

VERSION_NUM="${TAG#v}"
ASSET="gate_${VERSION_NUM}_linux_${ARCH}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/minekube/gate/releases/download/${TAG}/${ASSET}"

echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -sL -o gate "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
chmod +x gate

echo "Installed Gate ${TAG} (linux/${ARCH})"

if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
    echo "No config.yml found, generating a default '${GATE_CONFIG_TYPE:-lite}' template..."
    ./gate config -t "${GATE_CONFIG_TYPE:-lite}" -w
else
    echo "Existing config.yml found, skipping."
fi

case "${PROXY_PROTOCOL}" in
    true|false) PP_VALUE="${PROXY_PROTOCOL}" ;;
    *) PP_VALUE="false" ;;
esac
sed -i "0,/^  proxyProtocol:/{s/^  proxyProtocol:.*/  proxyProtocol: ${PP_VALUE}/}" config.yml
echo "Set proxyProtocol to ${PP_VALUE}"

echo "-------------------------------------"
echo "Install complete. Edit config.yml (Lite routes, etc.) before starting."
echo "Note: changing the 'Receive PROXY Protocol' variable after install will not update the config file. You must update the config file manually."
echo "-------------------------------------"

variables.name: Gate Version
variables.description: The minekube/gate release tag to install, e.g. 'v0.65.0'. Set to 'latest' to always fetch the newest release at install time.

variables.name: Initial Config Template
variables.description: Only used on install (when no config.yml exists). Defines which 'gate config --type' template to generate: full, simple, lite, bedrock, or minimal. Defaults to 'lite' since this egg is set up for Gate Lite mode.

variables.name: Receive PROXY Protocol
variables.description: Sets config.proxyProtocol in config.yml. Enable (true) only once your upstream (e.g. Pangolin, CF Tunnels) is confirmed to be sending PROXY protocol headers - every connection to this port must then arrive wrapped, or Gate will silently drop it (including direct/local connections).
